summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed successfully. All core features working as expected. MoneyFlow app is fully functional with proper persistence, recurring transactions, budget tracking, insights, and settings management.

issues: Amount input field does not show placeholder '0' when empty in edit mode - shows blank instead

critical_code_review_comments: All testID attributes properly implemented across components
AsyncStorage persistence working correctly with key @moneyflow/state/v1
Recurring transaction materialization logic works as expected - weekly transaction dated 21 days ago generated 4 copies (original + 3 weekly occurrences)
Theme toggle, currency selector, and all settings features functional
Budget tracking with over-budget warnings working correctly
Search, filter, and sort functionality on transactions tab working properly
Category management allows custom categories with proper validation
Charts (LineChart, PieChart, BarChart) from react-native-gifted-charts rendering correctly
Mobile-first design with proper touch targets and spacing
CSV export button present (will fail on web due to expo-sharing limitations - expected behavior)
seed_data_creation: Test data created: 3 manual transactions (1 income ₹5000, 2 expenses ₹500+₹200), 1 recurring weekly transaction ₹100 (materialized into 4 total), 1 custom category 'Health', budget set to ₹10000
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. App uses AsyncStorage for local persistence. Recurring transactions materialize correctly on app hydration. Currency changes reflect everywhere. Budget tracking with over/under budget states working. No backend integration needed.

first_launch_currency_picker.details: INR selected by default, Get Started button navigates to dashboard, firstLaunch flag persisted correctly

dashboard_elements.details: Balance card with ₹ symbol, Income/Expense totals, FAB button, chart toggle (Week/Month), quick cards all render correctly

add_transaction.details: Modal opens, amount/category/note/date/recurring inputs work, save persists data, transaction appears in list and dashboard

edit_delete_transaction.details: Edit modal populates existing values, changes save correctly, delete button triggers confirmation alert

recurring_transactions.details: Weekly recurring transaction dated 21 days ago materialized into 4 total transactions (original + 3 weekly copies)

transactions_search_filter_sort.details: Search by note/category works, Type filter (All/Income/Expense) works, Category filter works, Sort (Newest/Oldest/Highest) works

categories_management.details: Default categories show lock icon, custom category creation works with name/icon/color selection, delete only available for custom categories

insights.details: Net savings card displays correctly, donut chart and bar chart render, category breakdown with percentages, period toggle (This Month/All Time) works

budget.details: Budget input and save works, progress bar displays, spent/remaining calculated correctly, over-budget warning appears when exceeded, category breakdown shows

settings_theme.details: Theme toggle switches between dark/light palette instantly

settings_currency.details: Currency picker accessible from settings, changing currency updates all amounts throughout app (tested INR ↔ USD)

settings_csv_export.details: CSV export button present and clickable (expected to fail on web due to expo-sharing native dependency)

settings_clear_data.details: Clear data button triggers confirmation alert

settings_social_login.details: Google and Facebook sign-in buttons show 'coming soon' alerts as expected

persistence.details: After page reload, app loads directly to dashboard (not currency picker), all transactions/budget/settings persist correctly via AsyncStorage
